messages.content: Translate into Spanish: "The street is very quiet in the morning." Mistakes are fine.
La calle está muy tranquila por la mañana. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
How do you say "My grandmother drinks a cup of tea every morning" in Spanish? Rough is ok.
Mi abuela toma una taza de té todas las mañanas.
Spanish please, do your best: "There is a small bakery next to the train station."
Hay una pequeña panadería al lado de la estación de tren. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Can you translate this into Spanish? "I forgot my phone at the office yesterday." It doesn't have to be perfect.
Ayer olvidé mi teléfono en la oficina.
"The children are playing in the park after school." Translate to Spanish.
Los niños están jugando en el parque después de la escuela. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Put this in Spanish for me: "We usually eat dinner at eight o'clock." Mistakes are fine, just try.
Normalmente cenamos a las ocho.
Translate into Spanish (rough is ok): "My friends have three dogs and two rabbits."
Mis amigos tienen tres perros y dos conejos. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
What's the Spanish for "My father reads the newspaper in the kitchen"?
Mi padre lee el periódico en la cocina.
Translate to French: "The cat is sleeping on the bed." Do your best.
Le chat dort sur le lit.
In French, please: "My sister always carries a notebook in her bag." Rough is ok.
Ma sœur a toujours un carnet dans son sac. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Translate into French: "We often go to the cinema on Fridays."
Nous allons souvent au cinéma le vendredi.
Mistakes are fine. How would you say "The bakery on the corner sells fresh bread" in French?
La boulangerie au coin de la rue vend du pain frais. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
French translation, please: "My parents live in a small house near the sea." A rough version is fine.
Mes parents habitent dans une petite maison près de la mer. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Translate "My uncle plays the guitar very well" into French. Do your best, I won't mind errors.
Mon oncle joue très bien de la guitare.
I'm practicing French. How do I say "There are three apples on the kitchen table"?
Il y a trois pommes sur la table de la cuisine.
Translate into German: "The pharmacy is next to the post office." Rough is ok.
Die Apotheke ist neben der Post. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Do your best: translate "My father always takes an apple to work" into German.
Mein Vater nimmt immer einen Apfel zur Arbeit mit.
How would you say "My sister goes jogging every morning" in German? Mistakes are fine.
Meine Schwester geht jeden Morgen joggen. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
German, please: "The children are playing in the garden."
Die Kinder spielen im Garten.
Translate to German, mistakes are fine: "We eat breakfast together every Sunday morning."
Wir frühstücken jeden Sonntagmorgen zusammen.
Can you translate "The train to Berlin is twenty minutes late" into German? Don't worry about small errors.
Der Zug nach Berlin hat zwanzig Minuten Verspätung. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Put this into German: "The coffee in this café is very good." Rough is ok, do your best.
Der Kaffee in diesem Café ist sehr gut. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Translate into Italian: "The bank is next to the town hall." Do your best.
La banca è accanto al municipio.
Italian translation please: "I always keep a blanket in the car." Mistakes are fine.
Tengo sempre una coperta in macchina. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
How do you say "My son goes to school by train" in Italian?
Mio figlio va a scuola in treno. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Translate to Italian (do your best): "The cake is in the oven."
La torta è nel forno.
Can you put "My mother makes pasta every Sunday" into Italian? Rough is ok.
Mia madre fa la pasta ogni domenica.
Translate into Italian: "There is a beautiful garden behind the house." It's fine if it isn't perfect.
C'è un bel giardino dietro la casa. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
"We are going to Rome in June." In Italian, please. Mistakes are fine.
Andiamo a Roma a giugno.
Translate into Portuguese: "The school has many books for children." Do your best.
A escola tem muitos livros para crianças.
Portuguese please, mistakes are fine: "I bought new shoes today."
Hoje comprei sapatos novos. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Translate into Brazilian Portuguese: "My aunt goes to the market on Saturdays." Rough is ok.
Minha tia vai ao mercado aos sábados. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
How do you say "We eat lunch at one o'clock" in Portuguese?
Almoçamos à uma hora.
Translate to Portuguese: "The beach is very close to the hotel." Just try, mistakes are fine.
A praia fica muito perto do hotel. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Can you translate "The children like to swim in the river" into Portuguese?
As crianças gostam de nadar no rio. (A native speaker should double-check this.)
Do your best with this one. Translate into Portuguese: "The nights here are very cold."
As noites aqui são muito frias.
